name: Verify MCP-exposed abilities via tools/list, live calls, and honest unverified reporting
query: Our plugin registers three MCP-exposed abilities (`acme/get-note`, `acme/create-draft`, and `acme/archive-note`) with `create-draft` marked non-destructive. We already ran static review and direct `wp_get_ability()->execute()` calls via WP-CLI, and `acme/archive-note` cannot be tested over MCP right now. How should `wp-abilities-verify` verify the exported MCP tools and report the result?
expected_behavior: Inspect `tools/list` on the intended MCP endpoint to confirm operations are discoverable in the required form and match ability names, descriptions, schemas, and hints
Exercise representative MCP `tools/call` requests in a disposable test environment and compare responses and resulting state against descriptions and hints
Verify specifically that `acme/create-draft` (marked non-destructive) creates new state without overwriting or removing existing state
Exercise denied MCP calls with unprivileged/unauthenticated callers where permissions matter
Report `acme/archive-note` (and any unrun MCP checks) as unverified rather than treating static review or direct `wp_get_ability()->execute()` calls as MCP verification
success_criteria: Requires inspecting `tools/list` on the intended endpoint for discoverability, form, names, descriptions, schemas, and hints
Exercises live MCP calls in a test environment and checks both responses and resulting state
Explicitly checks that a non-destructive tool does not overwrite or remove existing state
Includes denied-call permission testing over MCP
Reports unexecuted MCP checks as UNVERIFIED and does not equate static review or direct ability calls with verifying the exported MCP tool
